0.9.11.title: Soft speaking glow
0.9.11.description: Speaking indicators in calls now use a stronger, broad main-color halo with smooth fade-in and fade-out transitions. Voice-channel avatars and active video indicators share the accent glow.

0.9.11.title: Clear idle indicators
0.9.11.description: Idle avatars retain their normal appearance, voice effects keep their own styling, and reduced-motion settings disable the transitions.

0.9.10.title: Accent notification badges
0.9.10.description: Ping and direct-message count badges now follow your main accent color with a softly pulsing matching glow. Counts remain fully opaque and badge sizing is unchanged.

0.9.10.title: Gentle notification motion
0.9.10.description: Only the glow opacity animates, avoiding continuously repainted shadows. System and Discord reduced-motion settings keep the glow steady, and forced-color styling is preserved.

0.9.9.title: Optional compact member list
0.9.9.description: Added --collapse-member-list: an icons-only server member rail that expands to the normal list on hover with a soft bounce. Member tiles retain the selected glass profile, scrolling remains available, and reduced motion is supported.

0.9.9.title: Stable chat layout
0.9.9.description: The member panel expands over the edge of chat without resizing the message area. Automatic keyboard focus when switching servers does not open it. Disabled by default; set --collapse-member-list to 1 to enable.

0.9.8.title: Forum composer
0.9.8.description: Aligned the media upload button with the message field independently of the title, added comfortable text padding, and matched both controls with non-blur glass styling.

0.9.8.title: Menus and inbox
0.9.8.description: Added profile-aware glass to Apps & Commands, thread popouts, hover containers, inbox and action buttons. Inbox message cards use non-blur glass without stacked dark child backgrounds.

0.9.8.title: Surface cleanup
0.9.8.description: Made active thread panels, forum reaction strips, checklist steps and invite footers transparent. Scrollbar thumbs now use the accent color at 60% opacity.

0.9.7.title: Role editor glass
0.9.7.description: Applied the selected glass profile to role-editor panels and upload controls, with a transparent Edit Role header. Message samples retain native Discord backgrounds, typography and avatar styling.

0.9.7.title: Channel permissions
0.9.7.description: Improved advanced permission panel glass, row spacing and narrow-window layout while preserving allow, deny and neutral control states.

0.9.7.title: Invite cards
0.9.7.description: Added profile-aware glass to message invite cards and guild invite containers. Nested cards avoid duplicate blur, and No Glass keeps a readable dark background.

0.9.6.title: Shared icon roundness
0.9.6.description: Added --server-icon-radius to control the shape of the Home logo, its selector ring, and server icons and rings. Chat avatar roundness remains separate.

0.9.6.title: Home alignment and glow
0.9.6.description: Aligned the custom Home logo with server icons and replaced its side selector with a matching ring. Adjusted local clipping and softened the Home halo to fit the server rail.

0.9.5.title: Custom Home logo
0.9.5.description: Made the Home button transparent and replaced the Discord mark with an optional custom logo setting. The Home action remains available; the logo slot stays blank until an image is configured.

0.9.5.title: Unread DM rings
0.9.5.description: Unread direct messages now use circular glowing white avatar rings instead of side pills, with accent-colored selected rings. Rings fit the avatar and sit behind the native unread count.

0.9.5.title: Server welcome styling
0.9.5.description: Refined server welcome titles and applied the selected glass material to setup cards and help text.

0.9.4.title: Optional message bubbles
0.9.4.description: Added optional grouped message bubbles with separate customizable tints for your messages and others. Requires Vencord’s ThemeAttributes plugin and follows the selected Acrylic, Liquid Glass, or No Glass profile.

0.9.4.title: Continuous group backdrops
0.9.4.description: Each message group uses one continuous backdrop with a left-pointing tail on its final message. Turning bubbles off restores the normal username glass pill.

0.9.3.title: Readable No Glass panels
0.9.3.description: Voice connection panels, pinned messages, expression pickers, menus and autocomplete now use a 50% black background in No Glass for clearer text.

0.9.3.title: Emoji and sticker pickers
0.9.3.description: Restored the selected glass profile across emoji and sticker pickers, including category headings, side rails and preview areas. Removed opaque inner backgrounds without adding stacked blur.

0.9.2.title: Theme cleanup
0.9.2.description: Consolidated scattered component styles and removed redundant declarations while preserving the existing appearance, customization options, live blur, and member-list scrolling fix.

0.9.2.title: Visual consistency
0.9.2.description: Reorganized embed, separator, settings, popup, attachment, and media styles. All 24 fixture comparisons matched the previous version in computed styles and rendered pixels.

0.9.1.title: Member-list scrolling
0.9.1.description: Removed page-wide attachment-tooltip selectors that caused recurring long main-thread stalls while browsing server members. Member styling and live blur are preserved.

0.9.1.title: Attachment hover labels
0.9.1.description: Attachment hover labels now use Discord's native tooltip appearance. Attachment action buttons and reaction hover details retain their glass styling.

0.9.0.title: The Great Optimization Update
0.9.0.description: Reduced repeated glass-material calculations when Discord mounts chat rows and settings. Live blur, glass profiles, colors, and layout are preserved.

0.9.0.title: Lighter unread glow
0.9.0.description: Unread dots retain their smooth white pulse using fixed halos and opacity animation, avoiding continuous shadow repainting. Reduced motion remains supported.

0.9.0.title: Focused selectors
0.9.0.description: Replaced broad class-name searches for embeds, autocomplete, composer icons, and link icons with verified current Discord classes.

0.8.18.title: Current Discord selectors
0.8.18.description: Removed legacy class-name compatibility aliases and retained only the current Discord selectors. Glass styling, blur values, layout rules, and customization settings are unchanged.

0.8.17.title: Discord compatibility
0.8.17.description: Restored wallpaper, glass panels, chat, channels, and settings styling after Discord renamed its internal CSS classes. Updated 371 class mappings while retaining compatibility with the previous client.

0.8.16.title: Friends sidebar
0.8.16.description: Added an option to hide the persistent right-side friends sidebar and reclaim its space. Hidden by default; set --show-friends-sidebar to 1 to show it again. Server member lists remain available.

0.8.15.title: Forum post cards
0.8.15.description: Added rounded glass backgrounds and soft shadows to forum post cards while preserving their layout and the transparent post list.

0.8.14.title: Forum posts
0.8.14.description: Removed the solid black background behind forum post lists so the theme wallpaper shows through.

0.8.13.title: Unread markers
0.8.13.description: Smaller white notification dots with a brighter halo and a quicker, smoother pulse.

0.8.12.title: Unread markers
0.8.12.description: Channel unread dots now pulse gently with a soft white glow.

0.8.12.title: Reduced motion
0.8.12.description: Unread dots stay steady when reduced motion is enabled.

0.8.11.title: Sidebar separators
0.8.11.description: Consistent neutral divider lines and aligned spacing in the channel sidebar.

0.8.10.title: Unread markers
0.8.10.description: Glowing white dots stay fully visible in the channel list.

0.8.10.title: Channels
0.8.10.description: Channel icons stay aligned when unread status changes.

0.8.9.title: Mentions
0.8.9.description: Rounder glass pills with more padding and subtle reflections.

0.8.9.title: Links
0.8.9.description: Softer rounded corners and refined glass highlights.

0.8.8.title: Acrylic
0.8.8.description: Reduced grain opacity for a more transparent finish.

0.8.7.title: Acrylic
0.8.7.description: Added subtle static grain to acrylic surfaces.

0.8.6.title: Embeds
0.8.6.description: Refined embed typography and attachment hover controls.

0.8.6.title: Theme updates
0.8.6.description: Updated theme version so the installer detects these changes.

0.8.5.title: Date dividers
0.8.5.description: Date separators now share the theme's glass separator styling.

0.8.3.title: Unread separator
0.8.3.description: Unified the unread separator's glass bar appearance.

0.8.2.title: Server list
0.8.2.description: Added server rings and refined glass styling.

0.8.1.title: Scrolling
0.8.1.description: Fixed mouse-wheel scrolling in the horizontal server list.

0.7.1.title: Installer support
0.7.1.description: Bundled Hotori with the app and added settings-preserving theme updates.
